name: bless. minimal shopping habits
description:
Introducing bless, the perfect shopping companion that helps you adopt a mindful approach to shopping. Whether you want to keep track of your spending, declutter your living space, adopt a minimalist lifestyle, or make purchases that reflect your values, bless has got you covered. The whimsical raccoon guide will assist you in making thoughtful purchase decisions and developing a healthier relationship with material possessions.

Bless is more than just an app - it's a partner on your journey towards mindful consumption, offering insightful features and supportive guidance to make every purchase meaningful.

Mindful Wishlist:
Add the things you wish to buy and revisit them after a set period. This feature promotes thoughtful purchases, reduces impulsive buying, and encourages reflection on spending habits.

Expense Tracker:
Track your expenses, understand your spending habits, and align purchases with your values using an intuitive interface that simplifies the process.

Don't Want Anymore List:
Catalog items you decided not to purchase, keep track of your savings and reflect on your consumption choices. Most importantly, be proud of your mindful decisions.

Got Rid Of List:
Log your progress in decluttering your living space. Select how you've parted ways with your non-essential possessions, whether you sold them or gave them away. Revisit the list and experience the satisfaction of seeing how far you've come.

“Should I?” Test:
A feature that encourages thoughtful spending through reflective questioning before making a purchase. You'll learn to make informed decisions and adopt a mindful approach to consumption.

Educational Content:
Discover a collection of resources on mindful shopping, minimalism, and conscious consumerism. Our raccoon companion provides daily tips to help make mindful consumption effortless.

Shopping Shield:
Your online shopping experience just got much more mindful. If you feel that browsing shopping apps and websites risks your budget and distracts you from more important things in your life, install Bless Shield. Now, you can block certain apps and websites and even pick entire categories, like social media, to help you stay focused and mindful of your spending.

Challenges:
Who doesn't love a good challenge? Try out a week or a month of decluttering (get rid of one thing a day), mindful shopping (log every purchase to the app), or digital detox (no online shopping). The longer you keep it up, the easier it gets. Even if you don't complete the whole thing, don't lose your motivation; you can always start again!

Premium features:
Subscribing to the bless premium plan gives you access to a variety of handy features. You can easily set up and change currencies, track your shopping tendencies via colorful charts, and select your preferred raccoon icon. We appreciate your support and plan for many future updates!
